title: Git History Is a Pangenome: Repetition in Code Training Corpora and What Deduplication Removes, Keeps and Misses
abstract: arXiv:2611.27154v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Code models are increasingly trained on the full history of software repositories, every version of every file, rather than on a single snapshot. The tools that deduplicate training data were built for snapshots, and what they do to a history has not been measured. We measured it on a pre-registered random sample of 306 public repositories, 25 mature projects, and the 12 repositories behind the SWE-bench benchmark. A history is mostly repetition: in the vocabulary of text indexing, a pangenome, one text in many near-identical variants. The history of a typical repository holds the equivalent of 19 copies of its current code, and a mature repository holds 89. The reason is that each edit changes a few lines and leaves the rest of the file in place: nine tokens in ten of a changed file already existed before the change. translated_title: Git历史是一个泛基因组：代码训练语料中的重复现象以及去重所移除、保留与遗漏的内容
translated_abstract: 代码模型越来越多地在软件仓库的完整历史上进行训练，即每个文件的每个版本，而不是在单一快照上训练。用于训练数据去重的工具是为快照而构建的，它们对历史数据的作用尚未被测量。我们在预先注册的306个公共仓库随机样本、25个成熟项目以及SWE-bench基准背后的12个仓库上进行了测量。历史数据大部分是重复内容：用文本索引的术语来说，是一个泛基因组，即一份文本的众多近乎相同的变体。一个典型仓库的历史包含相当于其当前代码19份副本的内容，而一个成熟仓库则包含89份。原因在于每次编辑只改动几行，文件的其余部分保持不变：被修改文件中十分之九的token在变更之前就已存在。精确匹配去重无法移除这些副本中的任何一个，因为没有两个版本是完全相同的。大型训练流水线……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示Git仓库历史本质上是一个高度重复的“泛基因组”——典型仓库历史相当于其当前代码的19份副本，而专为快照设计的精确匹配去重方法完全无法移除这些历史重复内容。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals that Git repository history is a highly repetitive "pangenome"—a typical repo's history holds the equivalent of 19 copies of its current code—and exact-match deduplication built for snapshots removes none of these historical copies.
